parameters.name: ApplyEndTime
parameters.description: The UTC time when the quota application ends.

parameters.name: ApplyStartTime
parameters.description: The UTC time when the quota application starts.

parameters.name: BatchQuotaApplicationId
parameters.description: The ID of the quota application batch.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries to return for a single request.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 30.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token that marks the position from which you want to start the query.

>  An empty value indicates that the query starts from the beginning.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description:
The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service name.

>  To query the abbreviation of an Alibaba Cloud service name, call the [ListProducts](~~440555~~) operation and check the value of `ProductCode` in the response.

parameters.name: QuotaCategory
parameters.description:
The type of the quota. Valid values:

*   CommonQuota: general quota
*   FlowControl: API rate limit
*   WhiteListLabel: privilege

example.unifiedCli: aliyun quotas list-quota-applications-for-template --product-code ecs-spec --quota-action-code ecs.g5.2xlarge --batch-quota-application-id d314d6ae-867d-484c-9009-3d421a800000 --quota-category CommonQuota --next-token 4 --max-results 30 --apply-start-time 2023-05-22T16:00:00Z --apply-end-time 2023-05-22T16:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
